items.description: Greener pastures ranks U.S. cities based on the greenness of their available housing stock. In a graph, each line represent a city's greenness over time. You can hover over a line to see which city it represents and compare.
Track FedEx packages--with per-segment CO2 estimates.

Foodsta is a web application that allows users to find restaurants, and find pictures about the restaurants that were uploaded by Instagram users. This application utilizes Instagram and Google Maps APIs.
An example site mashing up click to call with Twilio and invoicing with FreshBooks. The app simplifies the job of tracking unpaid invoices and communications with clients about those bills.
After you have logged in to MapYourBuddies, this mashup will display your friends from Facebook on a Google Map and give gift recommendations from Amazon based on your friends favorite music.
DBStract is a free web app and database builder.

Check any national or international flights via your mobile. Send in a flights tail number i.e. NZ1 to YouTXTs 8808 shortcode and check for a flights real-time arrival, departure and delay information.
A community to search, rate, and review local restaurants or find a new place to eat.
Visualization of your favorite artists on the world map.
Google maps creation tool reminiscent of simple image-editing programs. Nicely done.
Call In Studio is a call-in platform designed for internet and radio show producers. Allows producers to accept, manage and screen calls for shows in an easy-to-use web- based interface.
Polish maps mashup.
Mashup of Joomla!, Amazon and Internet Video Archive.
Sophisticated interface for exploring the birds of North America. Combination of USGS and Audubon Society data. Required Flash 8.
Google Maps mashup of the Iles Sans Fil WiFi network in Montreal, Canada. Note: loads slowly.

BlueHire integrates an interactive voice response system where job candidates participate in an online interactive audio interview as part of a prospective employers job application and screening process. Each job candidates responses are stored for review by the prospective employer.
View service centers in both directions on Highway 401 between Montreal and Toronto. Tourist stops near Highway 401 are included, as well as traffic cameras for Toronto and Montreal.
Lets people reprint public domain books from Internet Archive and Google Books.
An integration that allows users to send files from their Box.net accounts directly into ConceptShare, where other users can discuss them and offer feedback in a real-time setting.
Contextualizing and situating the list of prisons and the human rights abuses in Tunisia. Mashup of database data with Google Maps, YouTube, Flash animations and Yahoo Q Beta search.
Get a list of frequent words/phrases used by specific twitter users.

Whereabouts London is a web application created by the Future Cities Catapult with the goal to explore what London could look like in the future based on how people live currently. It aims to use open data to explore and improve the quality of life in future cities.
Simple tool for adding an interactive store locator mapping to your website
Explore relationship between artists. Idea based on six degrees theory: no artist is separated from another by more than six other artists. 3rd place winner in Amazon developer contest.
Use this handy Jacktracker mashup to follow the TV show 24. Incorporates images and various plot details. Uses the Wayfaring.com features such as discussion boards for each waypoint.
MailPeak uses the Twilio API to turn webmail accounts into voicemail. Listen and send voice replies to your emails from any phone.

Connected with the Walgreens Balance Rewards program, this fitbit application allow users to keep track of their activity to earn Walgreens points. With a 'steps' program, customers will be able to set goals and view progress of their activities, while earning reward points at Walgreens.
The Consolidated Screening List (CSL) is a list of parties for which the United States Government maintains restrictions on certain exports, re-exports or transfers of items.
A tool for reverse IP lookup. This site's language is Turkish.
Aggregating news into categorized topics from online sources. Features include news cloud, rate news, news discussion, and more. Find local news, world news, and forums.
iBlueSky is a mind mapping application for the iPhone, and this mashup allows users to save mind maps from iBlueSky directly to their Box.net accounts.
Simple and intuitive search tool, allows displaying photo time and date taken in either a radial or standard X,Y axis plot.

This small app allows RescueTime users to try ProcrasDonate's time management incentive. For every hour procrastinated, users automatically donate to their favorite charities and causes. Feel good about procrastinating...a little bit.

Whapl is a mobile application that allows users to locate and share their locations with their friends. By using this application, individuals can determine locations (both theirs and their friends) to expedite the process of finding the appropriate places for meetups and social networking.

DocuSign for Microsoft is an eSignature application that is integrated with Microsoft Word. The application lets users to review and send documents for signature directly from the MS Office applications that they are using. The recipients are then able to sign the documents electronically using DocuSign.
findacar.us is a place to find new and used vehicles for sale, car dealerships, and reviews from all across the United States.
Pictajam lets users instantly create a public, shareable profile from their Instagram photo stream. Send and share images with anyone in the world.
Streetview and Swiss Maps is a google street view/aerial view combiner.
Japanese Umeshu (plum wine) community web site.
Mashing up the Google Feed API and Windows Live Search for isfeed: access to RSS files, this provides a river of news reading experience for recent posts around any keyword.
Track the most popular news and other threads online via RSSmeme. Integrates with FriendFeed API.
Type in your domain name and find out how your site scores. Uses a unique formula consisting of variables, such as backlinks and popularity, to calculate a score for each website entered.
